name: Bread (Sourdough)
siboNotes: TRUE sourdough (long-fermented) is lower in FODMAPs than regular bread. The fermentation process breaks down fructans. Look for authentic sourdough with just flour, water, salt, and starter - no added yeast.
preparationTips: Spelt sourdough is also an option
nutritionalHighlights: Easier to digest than regular bread
